(-ली f.) 
__1 A weapon, a cudgel or a short sword. 
__2 A stick shaped like a sword (Mar. गुप्ति). (करवालिका).

__1 The earth. 
__2 The middle arch of a niche; [[Gīrvāṇa.]]
N. of the daughter of मेधातिथि.
[इल्-क डीष्] A cudgel, a stick shaped like a sword, a short sword (करवाल).
N. of a demon conquered by Indra; न्याविध्यदिलीबिशस्य द्दह्ळा [[

इलीशः,
इल्लिशः A sort of fish, commonly hilsa or sable. इलीशोचितपीयूषो वाचा वाचामगोचरः [[Udb.]]

N. of a son of Taṃsu and father of Duṣyanta. 
-नी f. N. of a daughter of Medhātithi; [[Hariv.]]
